description: When a flag is set, it clears the flag and copies sixty-four 32-bit words from a global table into a second table. It then sets a global value from a chain of sentinel checks on three channel bytes and writes a constant to the state word. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: call_library_and_store_result
description: Program entry that calls a library routine through a stored base pointer and, when the returned value is non-zero, calls the library at a fixed offset. It then writes a result into a fixed low-memory location. It calls an empty stub routine.

name: copy_run_records_to_destination
description: Walks a table of run records, copying a stored word forward into a destination buffer and repeating each run for its count. It calls four unnamed routines per record and refers to one text label. It is called by two unnamed routines.

name: stub_returns_without_effect
description: The decompiled body is only a return, although the facts list two calls. It is effectively a stub with no visible behaviour.

name: unpack_backward_into_allocated_memory
description: Allocates memory through exec AllocMem and decodes a bit-packed stream backwards into it, copying literal and back-reference runs. It calls four unnamed routines and is called by three unnamed routines.

name: apply_offsets_and_dispatch_jump
description: Adds a value to a table word addressed from a base pointer, then either makes an indirect call through a computed table entry or scans a word stream for a matching value. It calls one library routine at a fixed offset and two unnamed routines.

name: spin_countdown_delay
description: Runs an empty countdown loop from a value passed in a register and returns. It is called by two unnamed routines.

name: run_intro_sequence_then_restore
description: Program entry that calls KILLDOS to take over the system, then SETUP_SCREEN, INITCODE and MAINCODE in turn, and finally REVIVEDOS to restore it. It returns the data register unchanged.

name: wait_while_flag_bit_set
description: Spins while the high bit of a global value is set, returning once it clears. The facts list joystick, screen colour and vertical position registers, but the visible body only reads the global.

name: disable_system_and_save_state
description: Opens the graphics library and forbids task switching, then waits for two vertical blanks. It saves the DMA and interrupt enable registers, disables all interrupts, points the copper at its list and sets the DMA control register. It calls one unnamed routine and WAITVBL.

name: restore_saved_dma_and_interrupts
description: Restores the saved DMA and interrupt enable values with the set bit, points the copper list at the graphics view field and calls exec Permit to end the forbid. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: wait_for_flag_then_halt
description: Spins until a global value reaches minus one, then enters an endless loop with no further work. The facts list vertical position and other custom register touches, but the body only reads the global.

name: fill_bitplanes_and_set_size
description: Calls the bitplane fill routine, then writes a size word and a mode word into the screen structure at fixed offsets. It calls one routine, BPLFILL.

name: split_long_into_two_words
description: Splits a 32-bit value into high and low words and writes them to two fixed offsets of the structure at the address passed in. It is called by fill_bitplanes_and_set_size.

name: call_text_routine_twice
description: Calls the text drawing routine twice in sequence and returns. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: wait_until_flag_bit_clears
description: Spins while a particular flag bit in a global value is set, returning once it clears. The facts list the CIA port A register, which holds the fire button state, but the body reads only the global.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitmap
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into a bitmap one character at a time, writing each glyph byte into eight rows spaced forty bytes apart. A newline moves the output 320 bytes down to the next line. It is called by call_text_routine_twice.

name: stub_returns_minus_one
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is labelled as an author stub and has no visible behaviour beyond the return value.

name: trap_then_halt_at_entry
description: Program entry that raises exec trap zero through a single call and then loops forever with no further work. It calls one unnamed routine.

name: set_colour_and_enable_registers
description: Writes the background colour register and the DMA and interrupt enable registers, using the set-bit convention for the two enable registers. It calls two unnamed routines and is called by one unnamed routine. The decompiled body timed out, so only these facts are described.

name: call_one_unnamed_routine
description: A 17-instruction routine referenced by address that is called by one unnamed routine and calls one unnamed routine. Its decompiled body timed out, so only these reference facts are described.

name: stub_two_instruction_gap
description: A two-instruction block reached only through gap decoding, with no decompiled body available. It is treated as a stub with no described behaviour.

name: stub_two_instruction_entry
description: A two-instruction routine referenced by address and called by one unnamed routine, with no decompiled body available. Only those reference facts are described.

name: patch_calls_and_nops
description: Checks the first word of its input for a fixed pattern, then writes call-instruction and no-operation encodings at many fixed addresses, patching code in place. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns minus one with no other work. The reference run executed it and it is entered from outside the static flow.

name: wait_and_reply_port_message
description: Finds the current task, waits on its message port and then forbids task switching while it takes a message and replies to it. It calls one unnamed routine and uses a global base value.

name: open_libraries_and_init_state
description: Opens libraries through the exec base, closes any that fail, and calls library routines at several fixed offsets to set up state. It calls four unnamed routines and is called by one unnamed routine.

name: search_text_for_pattern_match
description: Searches a text buffer for an eight-character pattern, ignoring case and treating spaces as wildcards, and scans forward until the count runs out. It returns zero when a match is found and minus one when the count is exhausted. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: open_library_and_copy_name
description: Opens a library by name through the exec base, stores its base address and copies a list of name strings into a buffer, counting the characters copied. It calls library routines at fixed offsets and closes the library when done.

name: open_library_and_copy_header
description: Opens a library through the exec base, allocates a block through a second library routine and copies a 60-byte header from a global table into it. It then calls further library routines to fill in two fields and calls one unnamed routine.

name: install_library_function_hook
description: Opens a library, checks available memory and allocates a block. It uses exec Disable and Enable around a SetFunction call to replace a library vector. The visible body matches the routine before it, and the SetFunction replacement appears in the listed facts.

name: compute_complemented_word_sum
description: Sums twenty-three words starting at a fixed offset in a block and stores the one's complement of the total at another offset. It has no return value.

name: check_memory_size_and_allocate
description: Compares a size field against a fixed value and returns early when it matches. Otherwise it compares two memory-size values against a fixed limit, allocates a block through a library routine, copies a 265-byte header into it and calls further routines. The decompiled jump table could not be recovered.

name: finish_list_walk_then_allocate
description: Checks a loop counter against the end of a list and runs the size-and-allocation tail once the list is finished. It calls two unnamed routines and is called by one unnamed routine.

name: sum_flagged_entries_then_allocate
description: Walks a linked list, adding the difference of two fields to a total for each entry whose flag bits are set, then runs the size and allocation tail when the list ends. It is called by one unnamed routine and calls one unnamed routine.

name: sum_list_entries_with_flag
description: Walks a linked list and adds the difference of two fields to a total for each entry whose flag bit is set, then runs the size and allocation tail when the list ends. It is called by two unnamed routines and calls three unnamed routines.

name: allocate_header_copy_and_dispatch
description: Allocates a block through the exec library, copies a 265-byte header from a global table into it and stores the pointer. It then calls two unnamed routines and dispatches through a library-style table entry. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: set_field_then_dispatch_library
description: Stores a computed address in a structure field, calls one unnamed routine, then makes an indirect library call through a stored base at a fixed offset. The decompiler could not recover a jump table for that call. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: walk_list_until_flagged_entry
description: Follows a linked list from a fixed offset until it reaches an entry whose flag bit is set, then returns. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: compute_complemented_word_sum
description: Sums twenty-three words starting at a fixed offset in a block and stores the one's complement of the total at another offset. It has no return value and is called by two unnamed routines.

name: call_library_when_field_set
description: When a field in the block is non-zero, calls a library routine at a fixed offset through a base pointer. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: call_two_library_routines
description: Calls two library routines at fixed offsets. Its decompilation timed out, so only the listed library and caller facts are described. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: copy_and_patch_code_block
description: Program entry that copies a block of longwords into the code area, then writes fixed values into a range of fixed addresses before making three unnamed calls.

name: select_half_or_input
description: Returns half of a second word when a flag equals one, otherwise returns the input word unchanged. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: mask_input_with_table_entry
description: Looks up a word in a table at a fixed base, indexed by a register value doubled, and returns the bitwise AND of that entry with the input word. It is called by two unnamed routines.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the working block into the buffer passed in, when that buffer pointer is non-null, then makes an indirect call through a stored code pointer. It is called by find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: initialize_system_libraries
description: Program entry that finds the current task, opens the required system libraries including the DOS library through the exec base, then calls routines at fixed library offsets to set up the environment and reply to messages. It refers to a raw console window specification.

name: free_blocks_and_restore_patch
description: Program entry that calls two unnamed routines, then loops over five memory blocks calling exec FreeMem for each. Finally it restores a saved word in a fixed table when a masked pattern matches.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a local counter until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is called from find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: open_library_then_jump
description: Opens a library through the exec base, waits for a result from a library routine, and finally makes an indirect call to a computed address. The surrounding flow contains bad instruction data, and the instruction count is only two, so only these reference facts and calls are described. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: open_dos_and_intuition_libraries
description: Boot program entry that opens the DOS and intuition libraries through the exec base, calls library routines at fixed offsets and then makes one unnamed call. The surrounding flow contains bad instruction data, so the body is only partly described.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The single instruction is bad data, and the decompiler truncates control flow there. It has no behaviour beyond that and is called by one unnamed routine.

name: copy_block_and_run_routines
description: Program entry that copies a block of bytes into a destination region, then runs a loop that calls an unnamed routine and writes into a colour register. It makes four unnamed calls and is called by one unnamed routine.

name: write_byte_return_halved_value
description: Writes the low byte of a length-like value into a destination word, keeping the high byte of another register. It returns the value halved with its top bit set. It is called by three unnamed routines.

name: shift_bit_register_by_count
description: Shifts a bit register right one step per count held in a data register, calling an unnamed routine to refill it whenever it empties. It is called by five unnamed routines and calls three unnamed routines.

name: call_trap_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine, sets a global to a fixed constant, then raises exec trap zero and returns zero.

name: set_global_and_trap
description: Stores the address of this routine in a global variable and raises trap zero. It is called by one unnamed routine, and the listed callee is the boot entry that finds the DOS library.

name: process_a5_state_loops
description: Initialises a byte and a word at fixed offsets in a structure addressed through register A5, then runs nested polling loops that wait for bytes to change state. It calls other routines during each wait and decrements a counter in a secondary loop. It calls six unnamed routines.

name: toggle_flag_and_update_table
description: Toggles a flag word in a structure and, when the result is zero, increments a counter and copies its value into four table entries spaced eight words apart. It is called by boot_entry.

name: toggle_flag_and_fill_buffer
description: Toggles a flag word in a structure and, when the result is zero and the counter stays non-negative after subtracting two, copies a value into four table entries spaced eight words apart. It is called by boot_entry.

name: unpack_compressed_table
description: Waits through 32 calls to an unnamed routine, then expands 32 words into a table by splitting each word into four 4-bit fields and storing negated values at strided positions. It calls one unnamed routine.

name: find_max_nibble_value
description: Scans the four 4-bit fields of a 16-bit value and keeps the largest one in a running maximum register. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: update_nibble_counters_periodically
description: Counts down a tick counter and, every fourth tick, walks 32 rows of a table. For each row it decrements non-zero nibble counters and, where a masked bit pattern does not match its stored value, adds a place-value increment. It is called by boot_entry.

name: decrement_and_reset_table
description: Counts down a tick counter stored in a structure and, every fourth tick, reduces the high, middle and low nibble fields of each of 32 table words by one when they are non-zero. It is called by boot_entry.

name: initialize_dma_and_copper
description: Saves the interrupt and DMA enable state, disables interrupts and DMA, and configures CIA and audio hardware states. It waits for the vertical position and calls six unnamed routines, and it sets the audio channel location register.

name: initialize_display_palette_table
description: Populates a table of four address pairs with incrementing register numbers and stride offsets, then fills eighty words with increasing offsets and zeros. It stores a pointer in the structure at the end. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: restore_saved_hardware_state
description: Disables all interrupts, restores the saved DMA and interrupt enable values, and stores a pointer and an input word into the copper registers. The facts also list two CIA control registers. It is called by boot_entry.

name: set_two_constant_flag_bytes
description: Writes a fixed byte into one global and a second fixed value into a flag global. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: store_interrupt_control_constants
description: Writes a fixed byte into one global and a fixed word into another, then returns the data register unchanged. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: populate_copper_pattern_table
description: Writes a set of fixed pattern words into a table, then fills a run of 80 long words with alternating constants and sets further pattern entries. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: read_status_and_fill_patterns
description: Reads the DMA control and interrupt enable status registers into a table, writes a set of fixed pattern words and fills a run of 80 long words, then calls one unnamed routine. It is an entry point reached by execution.

name: fill_pattern_tables_then_call
description: Writes a set of fixed pattern words and fills a table of long words with constant values, including a run of 48 entries, then calls one unnamed routine. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: search_marker_and_compute_entries
description: Searches a block for a fixed four-byte marker, then multiplies two stored fields and writes the derived products into a table of hardware-style entries. It calls one unnamed routine and is called by one unnamed routine.

name: copy_pattern_records_per_block
description: Copies pattern values from a table into a working area in a loop over a count, calling four unnamed routines per record and advancing through a record block. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: copy_rows_and_update_display
description: Copies rows of bytes from a source into a destination in counted loops, then polls the joystick and button state and updates the copper and DMA registers. It opens the graphics library through exec, calls eight unnamed routines and is called by three unnamed routines.

name: patch_calls_and_find_task
description: Calls exec FindTask, writes call and no-operation encodings into several fixed memory locations and stores a computed pointer. It then calls an unnamed routine through an indirect jump that the decompiler could not recover.

name: read_button_state_and_adjust
description: Checks the button state held in a global, sets a status field and a constant when a flag is clear, then decrements the global. The facts list the right and middle button register.

name: wait_for_interrupt_request_bit
description: Spins until a particular interrupt request bit appears in a global value, then clears it and returns the masked value. The facts list the interrupt request register read and write.

name: copy_pattern_tables_and_clear
description: Copies two tables of words into the working area, one of eighty-nine entries and one of thirty-nine entries, then fills a run of eighty words with zeros and offsets. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: scroll_offset_from_mouse_movement
description: Compares the stored mouse movement register with the last reading and, when it moves far enough, steps a pair of offsets by twelve and a counter by one in the matching direction. It calls three unnamed routines and is called by two unnamed routines.

name: program_blitter_rows_in_loop
description: Loops four times, waiting for the blitter to go idle and then programming its control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers for one row. It calls the blitter wait routine on each pass and is called by two unnamed routines.

name: program_blitter_rows_fixed_mode
description: Loops four times over the blitter, waiting for it to go idle and programming its registers with a fixed control word, size and modulo for each row. It calls the blitter wait routine on each pass and is called by two unnamed routines.

name: stub_undecompiled_entry
description: A two-instruction routine referenced by address and called by two unnamed routines. Its decompilation timed out, so only these reference facts are described.

name: stub_undecompiled_six_instructions
description: A six-instruction routine referenced by address and called by one unnamed routine. Its decompilation timed out, so only the reference facts are described.

name: run_boot_io_then_colour
description: Boot-block entry that sets up an I/O request, calls exec DoIO through the library base and writes the background colour register. It calls one unnamed routine, and the surrounding flow contains bad instruction data.
